description: Add or subtract durations (1:30:00, 2h 15m, -45 min, 1d 3h) optionally onto a clock time, or compute the exact elapsed duration between two clock times or ISO datetimes (handles overnight shifts). Runs on our server, files are deleted right after the call, nothing stored. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €9/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.001/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/time-calculator.

clockTime.description: Optional clock time to add the sum onto (mode=add), e.g. 08:30

durations.description: Durations, newline-separated or JSON array (for mode=add), e.g. 1:30:00\n2h 15m\n-45 min

end.description: End time or datetime (mode=diff), e.g. 17:45 or 2026-11-21 06:30

mode.description: add (sum/subtract durations) or diff (time between start and end)

start.description: Start time or datetime (mode=diff), e.g. 08:30 or 2026-11-20 22:00

name: time_calculator
title: Time Calculator API - add/subtract durations or calculate time between two timestamps
